Subject: Next Decision: Invoice Handling Pilot Proposal

Hi Morgan,

Following our recent discussions, I am writing to formally propose the six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. The goal is clear: evaluate whether we can achieve the desired 20% reduction in handling time.

To ensure this evaluation is rigorous, we must establish a measurable baseline first, as none currently exists. The proposed scope is strictly limited to this assessment; production rollout is explicitly excluded.

The investment for this targeted, low-risk evaluation is a fixed fee of $30,000.

Before we can commence work, our security team must complete their approval process to ensure secure access to your client data. This step is mandatory and protects your information.

While no start date has been approved yet, securing the decision on scope and fee is the critical next step. This will allow us to proceed with the necessary security clearance and mobilize the team promptly.

Could you please approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance, so we can move forward without delay?

Best regards,

[Your Name]

Write an email to Morgan, the client operations director, proposing the approved pilot and requesting the next decision. Make the proposal persuasive enough to move the discussion forward.
